description: clipWithPointer, the cut applied to a task's cleaned output. Input is {head, fill, count, tail, taskId}: the text is head, fill repeated count times, then tail. Expected: {text, truncated}. Past 30000 characters the first 8000 and last 22000 stay around a cut marker, and a footer names the task so the model can read the log with task_output.

cases.name: a short output comes back whole
exactly the limit is not cut
one over the limit is cut and points to the task
head and tail survive the cut
no task id means no footer
